lines.1: 「Isn't that way of thinking a little too childish?」
lines.3: 「You just took your anger out on everything in sight. You can't say that after such a spectacle.」
lines.5: 「Even I thought that was childish. He's the one trying to talk to you face-to-face, like a responsible adult.」
lines.8: 「If that is what makes someone an adult...」
lines.14: 「N-Now do you understand? I'm not a child.」
lines.20: That was either a headbutt or a kiss, right?
lines.21: I mean, she intended it as a kiss.
lines.22: I certainly felt the softness of her lips.
lines.23: It was sweet, but my teeth hurt much more.
lines.24: I'm glad Nagomi kissed me, though.
lines.25: But there was something deeply reckless about it.
lines.26: 「And if you're not a child, don't kiss me, turn bright red, and run away...」
lines.27: It leaves my heart feeling sweet, yet aching.
lines.28: 「Instead of happiness, my first thought is that she's in danger...」
lines.29: --Is this what people mean by a dangerous age for a girl?
lines.30: And it's summer, with dangerous temptations everywhere.
lines.32: As your upperclassman, and hopefully as a man too.
